scope: Intel Core Ultra X7 358H CPU-draft versus NPU-draft threshold validation; GPU draft excluded

platform.power_condition: PowerOnline=true, Discharging=false, Windows Balanced scheme; capture before and after every run
platform.interactive_state: local console session 1, not RDP, one active display; re-check and record before and after every formal session

qualified_openvino_source.limitation: The exact historical Transformers source was not recorded; see reports/358h/358H_PROVENANCE_AMENDMENT.md.

draft_runtime.representation: one common OpenVINO IR for CPU and NPU

process_affinity.rationale: Freeze the compute set identically for CPU telemetry-OFF latency and CPU telemetry-ON energy runs; logical CPUs 12-15 are excluded for the qualified collector. This was selected during pre-formal observer-isolation qualification, not after formal results.

condition_order.method: Python random.Random shuffle generated before formal data with seed 20260920

warmup.stability_rule: After warm-up 3, continue until the latest two throughput observations differ by no more than 5%; abort the cell if not stable by warm-up 5.

timing_boundary.synchronization: LLMPipeline.generate is synchronous; stop QPC is captured only after the complete GenerationResult returns. No asynchronous queue is used.
timing_boundary.secondary: OpenVINO GenAI TTFT, TPOT, generate and inference metrics

prompt_construction.base_text: Heterogeneous computing assigns work to processors with different strengths. A reproducible experiment records every configuration, timestamp, and device name. Correctness is checked before performance, and raw measurements are never discarded. Candidate tokens are verified in order, while timing and energy remain separate measurements.
prompt_construction.method: Repeat base_text, tokenize without special tokens, then take the first exact N tokens.

npu_compile_policy.cache_policy: reuse the AC-qualified and hashed Phase-0 cache blob; no compilation inside measured boundaries

phase1_primary_latency_track.memory_measurement: process RSS immediately before and immediately after each synchronous generate call; report both and delta without interpreting it as device-local memory
phase1_primary_latency_track.device_binding_per_run: Each run JSON records requested_device plus the SHA256 of the frozen lower-level EXECUTION_DEVICES evidence; session setup fails closed if the requested physical plugin is unavailable or the evidence does not match CPU/NPU.
phase1_primary_latency_track.aggregation: Report all repetitions; per-device/context median is primary with nonparametric 95% bootstrap CI (10000 resamples, seed 20260921).

energy_track.admission_rule: A device/domain may be reported only after its exact collector and representative workload pass the unchanged randomized 10 OFF + 10 ON absolute-median overhead gate at <=1%.

cpu_package.collector: Windows Energy Meter RAPL_Package0_PKG through direct PDH API
cpu_package.qualification_evidence: runs/358h/qualification_ac_20260918/telemetry_overhead_v7_phase1like_isolated/overhead_qualification.json; 10 OFF + 10 ON, seed 573, absolute median overhead 0.122423%, threshold 1%
cpu_package.integration: QPC-midpoint timestamps, linear boundary interpolation, trapezoidal integration

npu.reason: Latest minimal SocWatch attempt failed the unchanged 1% gate and package RAPL is not an isolated NPU boundary.

energy_track.comparison_rule: No symmetric CPU-versus-NPU energy comparison unless both device domains independently qualify and their physical boundaries are explicitly comparable.

phase2_predictive_gate.T_d_source: Phase-1 same-platform draft-device observations at the matching context and k=2.
phase2_predictive_gate.T_b_source: Same-platform explicit-GPU target-only Qwen3-8B Q8_0 steady-state single-token baseline at matching contexts, collected after Phase 1 under a frozen addendum; no M4/CUDA/B570 substitution.
phase2_predictive_gate.V_2_source: Same-platform explicit-GPU target verification-control observations for k=2, admitted only after the frozen six-problem exactness gate passes all 18 runs.

T_x.treatment: favorable-bound assumption only; prediction is not a realized end-to-end speedup claim

per_context_classification.GO: verification exactness is admissible, central median speedup >=1.05, and central 95% lower bound >1.00
per_context_classification.NO-GO: verification exactness is not admissible, or optimistic 95% upper bound <1.00

phase2_predictive_gate.overall_rule: GO only if every context is GO; NO-GO only if every context is NO-GO; otherwise BORDERLINE.

phase3_entry_and_validation.entry_rule: Only context points classified GO or BORDERLINE may enter Phase 3; stop the campaign if all contexts are NO-GO.

correctness_gate.pass_rule: all 18 speculative outputs exactly match the paired target-only token IDs

human_eval_30.primary_speedup_summary: geometric mean across prompt-level paired speedup ratios with prompt bootstrap CI

freeze_rule: Set status=FROZEN, fill repository_commit with the immutable protocol-content commit, and set formal_measurement_authorized=true only after Phase-0 PASS and a successful non-formal dry run; do so before observing any formal timing or energy result.
